question: If a conical vessel is of height 12cm and radius 6cm, then the volume of the conical vessel is
solution:
**Given:**

Height (h) = 12 cm

Radius (r) = 6 cm

**Formula used:**

Volume of cone = (1/3) × π × r² × h

**Calculations:**

Volume = (1/3) × π × 6² × 12

⇒ Volume = (1/3) × π × 36 × 12

⇒ Volume = (1/3) × π × 432

⇒ Volume = 144π cm³

**∴ Volume of the conical vessel = 144π cm³**
